prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Orin and Fen. Character visual motifs: scarred human lantern scout followed by a blind, horned dusk-hound made of moving ember fur; **not** a wolf plus death-immunity circle.
TOP LEFT: Scent of Trouble. Ability concept: Fen marks heroes who recently damaged Orin's allies, revealing their direction for 3 s (not through fog beyond a short final ping).
TOP RIGHT: Track Lantern. Ability concept: Orin drops a lantern that records the next enemy who passes within 55 GU, pinging their direction; can be destroyed in 2 hits.
BOTTOM LEFT: Fen, Guard. Ability concept: sends Fen to a chosen ally or lantern for 3 s. Fen absorbs the next **one** eligible hostile projectile and then withdraws, with a clearly visible charge indicator.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Road Home. Ability concept: paints a luminous curved **retreat path** from Orin to one low-HP ally for 4 s. The selected ally may voluntarily follow it for 30% speed and 18% damage reduction while moving toward Orin; leaving the path cancels protection. No HP floor or mass invulnerability.
